description.value: Nomad So.Cial Eatery is an independently owned restaurant in Hope, BC, built around a culinary philosophy it calls Rocky Mountain food — rugged, backcountry-inspired cooking blended with health-conscious choices. The restaurant leans into Hope's layered history as a gold rush waypoint and railway gateway, positioning itself as a destination stop for travellers moving through the Fraser Canyon corridor. Lunch and dinner menus rotate seasonally, and the kitchen offers catering services alongside periodic special dining events.
